params.name: colNum
params.description: Number of the cell column (still required, even if unused, when rowNum is -4 or -5)

params.name: rowNum
params.description: Reference of the cell row, or a negative constant designating a special report area

sentinelValues.meaning: qr title -- title area of the report
qr detail -- detail area of the report
qr grand total -- grand total area

params.name: property
params.description: Text attribute to assign, from the QR Text Properties theme (e.g. qr bold, qr font size, qr justification, qr font name, qr background color, qr alternate background color)

params.name: value
params.description: New value for the attribute selected by property; its concrete type (Integer flag/size/color number, or Text font name) depends on which property is targeted

overloads.semanticRole: Sets a single text-display attribute (font, size, style, color, justification, ...) of the cell identified by colNum/rowNum.

constraints: In cross-table mode, row values used in rowNum are always positive (the negative title/detail/grand total/header/footer constants are a list-mode-only convention).
